title: FundingRaffle
tagline: Practical, anonymous, and publicly verifiable Funding Raffles.
description: This project would give people an incentive to donate more. Currently, there are few incentives for the public to donate. Raffle Funding, however, will provide incentives to donate to projects and public goods. This project makes people donate by participating in a raffle where 50% percent of the total donation will be allocated to the selected project or public good, 40% will be distributed to the lucky raffle winner and, 10% will be used to maintain and develop the platform to ensure sustainable growth and impact.
how_its_made: The backend and frontend is built using Vite, JavaScript, and Thirdweb. We deployed a solidity contract onto the Base Chain TestNet. The Base Chain Test Net was very easy to use and super efficient. On the frontend and backend side, Vite and Thirdweb gave us the easiest and quickest way to get the client side up and running and connect back to the web3 aspect of the project.
